knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An unknown finish with damaged protection starts with the gentlest approved product, tested first.
The hidden test shows whether the product damages the finish before the wider work goes ahead.
An applicator keeps the product where it is needed and off the paint.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the finish of two wheel types and one trim piece on a sample, and records the identification.
Refuses an unsuitable product on a simulated damaged-coat wheel, and records the refusal and the reason.
Completes a compatibility test record on an inconspicuous area, including a check after drying.
passRule: Finishes identified, refusal recorded, and compatibility test record complete, observed by an assessor. A quiz pass is not a practical pass.
stopWorkCriteria: Acidic or unlabelled product used on an unknown or damaged finish
Wider treatment started without a recorded test
Product sprayed onto paint or screens
